title: Daily Spendable
summary: How much can I safely spend before my next paycheck?
description: A paycheck-cycle sheet. It returns a safe-to-spend lump and a daily amount from the cash and bills you enter. It does not add the next paycheck, and it does not advise.
buyerProvides: Cycle-start cash, cadence, and the next payday. Optional hold-back, buffer, bills, plans, sinking funds, and a spend log.
returns: Safe-to-spend lump, daily amount, days until payday, spoken-for split, status, the next three outgoings, and a payday checklist.
license: Personal use. The buyer keeps their copy. Do not resell or share the file.

title: Debt Payoff Tracker
summary: If I pay extra, when is each debt gone under snowball versus avalanche?
description: Compares a snowball order and an avalanche order from the balances you type. Dates assume the planned payments are made. It is not a credit product.
buyerProvides: Each balance, its rate, its minimum, and any extra you plan to pay.
returns: Debt-free date, interest, an order comparison, and a period plan.

files.filename: ELVORIA Debt Payoff Tracker — COPY ME.xlsx

license: Personal use. The buyer keeps their copy. Do not resell or share the file.

title: Sinking Funds Tracker
summary: How much must I put aside each period so each dated goal is full on time?
description: Tracks dated goals and the amount still required this period. Status is ready, saving, due now, or missing a date.
buyerProvides: Each goal, its date, and what is already set aside.
returns: Required this period, remaining, pace, and a status for each goal.
features: Ready, saving, due, or missing date

files.filename: ELVORIA Sinking Funds Tracker — COPY ME.xlsx

license: Personal use. The buyer keeps their copy. Do not resell or share the file.

title: Paycheck Calendar
summary: Which bills fall between today and the next deposit?
description: A printable map of bills between now and the next deposit. No calculation engine.
buyerProvides: Bill names and the dates they fall due.
returns: A visual map. No calculation.
features: Bills placed against the next deposit
license: Personal use. The buyer keeps their copy. Do not resell or share the file.

title: Cash Envelope Starter Kit
summary: Print and separate discretionary cash by category.
description: Printable category inserts for cash envelopes. Not a bank, and not a spreadsheet.
buyerProvides: Category names. Print and cut.
returns: Physical category inserts.

title: Subscription Annualizer
summary: What do these recurring charges cost per year, and which do I cut before renewal?
description: Turns recurring charges into a yearly total and lists the next renewals. Cutting a row is your edit, not a recommendation engine.
buyerProvides: Each recurring charge, its amount, and its renewal date.
returns: Annualized total, monthly equivalent, cut potential, and the next five renewals.
license: Personal use. The buyer keeps their copy. Do not resell or share the file.

title: Emergency Fund Calculator
summary: Using my must-pays, what is my runway target and when do I hit it?
description: Builds a target from the must-pays you enter and counts periods to that target. Status is no target, saving, or ready.
buyerProvides: Must-pay amounts and what is already saved.
returns: Target, remaining, periods to goal, funded date, percent, and status.

title: Dual Paycheck Allocator
summary: How do two pay dates cover shared bills without one side going negative?
description: Splits shared bills across two pay streams and flags a side that would go negative. It does not move the money.
buyerProvides: Two pay dates, shared bills, and what each stream can cover.
returns: A safe amount per stream, transfer lines, and two statuses.
license: Personal use. The buyer keeps their copy. Do not resell or share the file.

title: Variable Income Planner
summary: What is safe this cycle when deposits are uneven, without treating a boom as the baseline?
description: Sets a this-cycle safe amount from uneven deposits. A boom is flagged. It is not used as the new baseline.
buyerProvides: Uneven deposits for the cycle and the bills that stay.
returns: This-cycle safe amount, a daily split, a boom flag, and a status.
